name: Bloodmage: Running Wild plays the Accursed Form blood burst when transforming
contract: Running Wild 800175 has no SpellVisual in the installed client Spell.dbc, so the transform into worgen creature
56332 showed no effect. Accursed Form 562572 uses SpellVisual 15283, whose impact kit SpellVisualKit 14140 is
Spells\BloodyExplosion.mdx on the chest with no animation. Its cast kit 14122 carries the blood hands with cast
animation 54, which the transform should not play, so only the impact kit is used (maintainer decision).
Expected: when the Running Wild aura is applied and the player transforms, the server sends
SMSG_PLAY_SPELL_VISUAL (0x1F3: unit guid, then kit id) with kit 14140, and ending Running Wild sends none.
